chats.answer:
If you're looking for open-ear headphones with a microphone, especially for calls, Zoom meetings, or everyday use, I'd recommend models that let you hear your surroundings without blocking your ears.

There are two main styles:

Open-ear earbuds: Lightweight, hook around your ears, and work well for music and phone calls.

Open-ear headsets with boom microphones: Better for work meetings, especially when microphone clarity matters.

Here are some options worth comparing.

Recommended models

Shokz OpenComm2 UC (2025)

Best for calls and meetings
$199.95

Noise-canceling boom microphone, USB dongle, and up to 16 hours of talk time. Ideal for Zoom and Teams. 
RTINGS.com

SHOKZ Open Fit 2+True Wireless Bluetooth Earbuds Black

$195.95

Best all-around ear-hook option for music, calls, and exercise. Built-in microphones, no boom arm.

Soundcore AeroFit 2

Budget pick
$99.99

Adjustable ear hooks, built-in microphones with AI call processing, and a comfortable open-ear design.

Bose Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen)

$299.99

Premium clip-on design with built-in microphones. Better suited to comfortable everyday listening than microphone-first office use.

Which should you choose?

For microphone quality above everything else, I'd choose the Shokz OpenComm2 UC. For a more discreet pair that works for both calls and music, the Shokz OpenFit 2+ is a stronger fit.
